TeamPCP poisoned Checkmarx GitHub Actions and OpenVSX extensions. The payload hunted CI, cloud, SSH, Kubernetes, and developer credentials from trusted scanning tools.

2026-04-08

DAEMON Tools installer delivered QUIC RAT

Target: DAEMON Tools | Impact: backdoor, data_theft, remote_access

Official signed DAEMON Tools Lite installers were trojanized from April 2026. The backdoor profiled machines, then selectively delivered a minimal backdoor and QUIC RAT.

2026-04-09

CPUID installers delivered STX RAT

Target: CPUID | Impact: credential_theft, remote_access, session_theft

CPUID's official download flow redirected HWMonitor and CPU-Z users to attacker infrastructure. Trojanized HWMonitor 1.63 sideloaded cryptbase.dll and unpacked STX RAT.

2026-04-22

Checkmarx channels shipped stealers

Target: Checkmarx release channels | Impact: credential_theft

A second Checkmarx wave hit DockerHub, GitHub Actions, VS Code Marketplace, and OpenVSX. The affected artifacts again put developer and CI credentials at risk.

2026-05-06

JDownloader CMS served trojanized installer

Target: jdownloader | Impact: malware_delivery

Attackers changed selected JDownloader website links to malicious third-party files. The real installers and RSA-signed in-app updater were not modified.

2026-05-09

Checkmarx Jenkins plugin shipped backdoor

Target: Checkmarx Jenkins AST Scanner | Impact: credential_theft

A malicious 2026.5.09 Checkmarx AST Scanner release reached the Jenkins Marketplace. The plugin put CI systems at risk by running attacker code inside trusted build infrastructure.
